description: The range and feedback controls of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: SvSlider as a single or dual-thumb range with ticks, keyboard control and a vertical option, and SvGauge as a radial arc with threshold bands, a needle and a half sweep. Both are theme-driven value controls that work standalone or inside grid cells; the demo shows a volume slider with a value readout and five ticks beside a temperature gauge.

faq.question: How do I show the current slider value?
faq.answer: Set showValue and the slider prints the value next to the thumb; ticks={5} draws five evenly spaced marks along the track.

faq.question: How does the gauge colour its arc?
faq.answer: Through bands, an array of { from, to, color } ranges painted along the arc; the needle points at value and unit is appended to the readout.

faq.question: Are the controls keyboard accessible?
faq.answer: Yes. The slider thumb is a slider role with arrow, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down keys, and the gauge is a read-only meter announced with its value.
